name: The Woven Practice
tagline: A distinctive visual language for interconnected lives.
typography: Georgia with italic accents; Arial for body and practical information.
rationale: Custom interwoven linework introduces a memorable identity without generic nature photography. The metaphor allows complexity without claiming a specific treatment orientation.
mobile: Centered hero stays legible at 60px, decorative weave crops intentionally, service concepts become concise rows, remaining sections stack.
supporting: About profile, verified approach explanation, confirmed service slot, fee/access/inquiry FAQ.
trust: Plain-language explanation and real profile information temper the poetic metaphor. No assumptions of family or couples qualifications.
seo: Use literal service terminology alongside the metaphor in final headings and metadata. SVG is lightweight and decorative; important information remains HTML.
tradeoff: The metaphor can become vague if overused. Pair it with concrete verified services and clear logistics; avoid implying systemic/family training until confirmed.
accessibility: Thread artwork conveys no required information. Keep the central heading readable on narrow screens, and ensure plum and muted terracotta text are used on suitable backgrounds.
